packaging.units_per_box: how many parts go in one box; the value is the number only, e.g. 36
packaging.label_language: the language or languages of the box label
packaging.pallet_layers: the maximum number of box layers on a pallet; the value is the number only, e.g. 3
gauge_calibration.interval: how often gauges are calibrated; the value is the period only, without the word 'every', e.g. 9 months
gauge_calibration.owner: who is responsible for calibrating the gauges
leak_test.pressure_bar: the test pressure in bar; the value is the number only, e.g. 1.5
leak_test.hold_seconds: how many seconds the test pressure is held; the value is the number only, e.g. 10
cleaning.solvent: the solvent used to clean fixtures
cleaning.interval_hours: the number of hours between cleanings; the value is the number only, e.g. 4
